name: Synthetic Lover
source:
In the year of 2066, biologically engineered humanoids known as ‘biots’ make up a large percentage of the workforce.

The protagonist of Synthetic Lover is one such biot and, like the rest of his colleagues, he lives to serve a single purpose – to fulfil his pre-programmed vocation. In his case, that’s to be a companion in an adult entertainment center known as Dollhouse.

Biots are servants who exist as lifeless dolls until being activated upon request, their self-awareness is sealed off by design, taking with it their ability to think or feel of their own free will… That’s how the protagonist’s days go until the chance appearance of an opportunistic thief with a mysterious device in his possession…

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231001031758/https://www.syntheticlover.com/]official website[/url], archived from [url=https://www.syntheticlover.com/]original[/url] on 1 Oct 2023]
translation:
2066年，被称为“生物人”的生物工程类人动物占劳动力的很大一部分。

《合成情人》的主角就是这样一个生物，和他的其他同事一样，他活着就是为了一个目标——完成他预先设定的使命。对他来说，那就是成为一个名为“玩具屋”的成人娱乐中心的同伴。

比奥特是仆人，他们以没有生命的玩偶的形式存在，直到根据要求被激活为止，他们的自我意识被设计封闭，带着他们思考或感受自己自由意志的能力……这就是主角的日子，直到一个机会主义的小偷偶然出现，他拥有一个神秘的装置……

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231001031758/https://www.syntheticlover.com/]官网[/url]，存档于[url=https://www.syntheticlover.com/]原始[/url]，2023年10月1日]
